blockers: The advertised Sign in and Dashboard links lead back to /docs; /checkout, /subscribe, /signup, /login, /dashboard, /account, and /billing return 404.

The [OpenAPI specification](https://api.drift-flight.org/openapi.json) exposes models, presets, and authenticated image generation only—no account, checkout, subscription, payment, or API-key provisioning endpoint.
No x402 endpoint or other programmatic-payment mechanism was found. The site describes human account creation, monthly card billing, and dashboard-issued keys.
No functional enrollment flow exists, so CAPTCHA, KYC, identity, or email-confirmation requirements cannot be ruled out.
Per-generation overage rates and concrete enterprise pricing are not published.
trust_events: Would warn before payment: [registry data](https://rdap.publicinterestregistry.org/rdap/domain/drift-flight.org) shows the domain was registered on 2026-07-20, less than three weeks before this investigation.
Exact-name searches found no independent footprint supporting Driftflight Studio, Inc., its API, or its customer testimonials.

The missing checkout/dashboard and nonfunctional sign-in path materially undermine the site's claims of an operating subscription service; merchant identity and provisioning would need verification before purchase.
notes: The primary service is a text-to-image API. [Published pricing](https://drift-flight.org/pricing): Hobby $5/month for 100 sketch-tier generations and a personal licence; Studio $29/month for 750 sketch/studio generations, commercial licence plus C2PA, and three seats; Agency $119/month for 3,000 generations through gallery tier, private presets, priority processing, and unlimited seats/SSO. Annual billing claims a 20% discount. [Terms](https://drift-flight.org/terms) state advance billing, no charge for failed renders, and defect-refund requests within 30 days. The service is identifiable and its base subscription terms are concrete, but it cannot be purchased or provisioned end-to-end through any discoverable path.
